name: Assign A Roll
description: Assigns A-roll clips to the timed spine based on clip catalog constraints.

inputs.name: project_fps
inputs.description: Timebase from the catalog. Every consumer used to read its own 30.0 default because no edge carried it.

inputs.name: audio_catalog
inputs.description: State input: audio_catalog - step 1.02's voiceover/music files in audio_001 numbering. Read for the audio file a voiceover-sourced speech block's words play from; a voiceover block with no intake entry is refused by name. Absent on runs whose catalog predates it.

outputs.name: voiceover_assignments
outputs.description: State output: voiceover_assignments - one entry per voiceover-sourced speech block (words from a catalogued audio file, picture from B-roll cover): spine_block_position, block_type, audio_id, source_file, audio_in/audio_out, duration_seconds and the block's timeline range. Empty on runs with no voiceover, which is the normal case. Read by compile_manifest, which places the audio on A1.
